label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Marib Camps
damage: 30-58 government troops killed, 50+ wounded across Homeland Shield, Emergency Forces and First Military Region camps
notes: Deadliest single episode of the Yemen conflict in years; troops caught during a morning training exercise. Houthis claim 45 killed.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Hadramout Camps
damage: Part of the combined Marib-Hadramout barrage; simultaneous with the Marib strike
notes: Fired from Al-Jawf governorate alongside the Marib barrage.

label: Houthi Projectiles → Najran, Saudi Arabia
damage: 11 civilians wounded incl. a 4-year-old with 2nd-degree burns; highest civilian toll in the Kingdom in 4+ years
notes: Coalition called it an indiscriminate attack on civilian objects. Signed same day as the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement.

label: Houthi Drones/Missiles → Jazan Refinery (1st Strike)
damage: Gasification unit and tank farm struck; refinery went offline
notes: First direct Houthi attack on Saudi oil infrastructure of the 2026 escalation. Houthis also claimed Yanbu targeting the same week.

label: Houthi Drone → Jazan Refinery (2nd Strike)
damage: Fire at the 400,000 bpd refinery, extinguished by dawn, no injuries reported
notes: Houthis said the strike responded to alleged Saudi drone incursions into Saada and Hajjah governorates, Yemen.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Al-Makha Port
damage: 7 killed per government count; Houthis say they destroyed boats and weapons of Saudi-backed forces
notes: Houthis said they targeted buildups of weapons and warships belonging to 'mercenaries' at the port.

label: Houthi Double-Tap Missiles → Cargo Ship Tihamah
damage: 4 crew killed (3 Pakistani, 1 Indonesian); 2nd missile on rescue op killed 2 Yemeni coast guard rescuers, wounding several
notes: First fatal Houthi attack on shipping since the Iran war began Feb 28. Houthis claimed the ship carried Saudi military equipment — not independently confirmed.

label: Houthi Ballistic Missiles → Al-Makha Port (2nd Strike)
damage: 4-8 killed (government count vs. unnamed military official's higher count); fishing boats set ablaze
notes: Government says civilian infrastructure targeted; Houthis say they struck Saudi-backed force buildups.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Abha International Airport
damage: All projectiles intercepted; no casualties reported
notes: First claimed Houthi attack on Saudi soil since the informal 2022 truce; retaliation for the government/Saudi strike on Sana'a airport's runway hours earlier.

label: Houthi Ballistic Missiles → Saudi Landing Ship, Off Mokha
damage: Houthis claim landing ship 'completely burned', escort boats sunk/ablaze; Yemeni government disputes target identity; no Saudi confirmation
notes: Single-source Houthi claim (spokesman Yahya Saree). Part of the maritime blockade of Saudi Arabia declared Jul 20.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Saudi Tankers Encelia, Layla
damage: Fires on both vessels; no reported casualties, all crew safe
notes: First reported vessel attack since the Jul 20 blockade declaration. Brent crude hit $100/bbl same day.

label: Saudi-Led Coalition Airstrikes → Hodeidah
damage: Military capability linked to shipping/refinery attacks; coalition says port itself not targeted
notes: First coalition strikes on Houthi-held territory since the 2022 truce.

label: Saudi-Led Coalition Airstrikes → Sana'a & Hodeidah
damage: Reciprocal strikes on Houthi military sites after the announced strikes on a Saudi ship and Jazan refinery
notes: Coalition reiterated Hodeidah port itself was not targeted.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Marib Displacement Camps
damage: At least 4 wounded, homes and civilian infrastructure damaged
notes: Six ballistic missiles and four drones struck residential neighborhoods and camps hosting part of Marib's 2M+ displaced population.

label: Houthi Missiles/Drones → Marib (5-Hour Barrage)
damage: Barrage from ~11:00-16:00 local; army air defenses shot down at least one drone over the city, no casualties reported
notes: Same day Yemen's Defense Council approved expansion of the government's air and missile deterrence posture.

label: Houthi Drones → Najran Airport & Aramco Facility (Claimed)
damage: Houthis claim both targets hit; no Saudi or Aramco confirmation of damage or casualties
notes: Single-source Houthi claim (spokesman Yahya Saree); framed as retaliation for alleged Saudi drone incursions over Saada province.

label: Yemeni Army Counter-Offensive, South of Marib
damage: Yemeni Army claims a 'successful operation' against Houthi positions; over 100 operations conducted in preceding 24 hours government-wide
notes: Part of the National Defense Council's raised readiness posture; outcome not independently verified.

label: Houthi Ballistic Missile → VLCC Amzan, Off Yanbu
damage: Fire on the main deck of the Saudi VLCC Amzan; all crew safe, no injuries or environmental damage reported
notes: Struck ~63nm west of Yanbu while sailing from Egypt; part of the Houthis' 'siege-for-siege' maritime ban on Saudi-linked shipping. Market reaction muted versus July's tanker strikes.
